summary: Assessment and learning for schools, in one place.
overview: ZIIV Assess is ZIIV’s assessment and learning platform for schools. Teachers build question banks, run exams online or on paper and publish accurate results.
Around assessment it brings lessons, homework, live classes, practice and a browser-based Code Lab together, on desktop and mobile.
